'''Tana's Resort''' was a resort owned by [[Tana (Human)|Tana]] on the tropical world of [[Rion/Legends|Rion]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Ionic Ring Ship]] [[Devastation of Rion|attacked]] Rion, turning it into an ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and driving the resort's inhabitants to starvation.
